LIGHT & WEATHER: One distant warm stable-lantern source with deep nocturnal shadows; wet sweat and real mud. Natural particles caused by physical contact only.
SURFACE: Tangible natural fur, wet scales, coarse cloth, stone or wood corresponding to subject; never plastic.
SETTING: A dark rural place at night where the horse is being ridden. [cagrino-c03]
MOOD: Formidable mythic awe or danger appropriate to source; benevolent guardians remain protective; living religions treated respectfully. Never cute, calm, static, ordinary human or decorative.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: No text, glyphs, inscriptions, logo, border, frame, watermark; no extra heads, limbs, fingers or attributes. No film/game/anime/comic design. No nudity or explicit gore. No generic glow aura, neon outline, floating runes, colored energy ribbons or unclaimed powers. Exact anatomy overrides generic associations.
